items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: when I was playing the Holy Ghost brass band... Pinchback Two-Rows directing the band.

ctx.x: Did the old brass bands use a lot more sheet music than today?

Yes, they did. They did. Because you see, and before, when you're playing the brass band, you have to rehearse them. See when I was playing the Holy Ghost brass band, my dad had a voice about my youth plant clarinet. I was a youngster, in my teens. But we had to rehearse them at the Holy Ghost Hall twice a week. And Landry was a first drummer with the band, and Pinchback Two-Rows directing the band. So we used to rehearse them twice a week, because they had to rehearse on that music, and if you didn't show up to…
And then I guess at that time it was, most of the fellas was mostly sheet men, I mean,
